name: Monroe (16)
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, this one-of-a-kind wig features a Level 8 beige-blonde balayage. A soft brunette root blends into a light brown base with fine sandy blonde highlights throughout. Brighter, creamy blonde pieces frame the face, giving her a neutral bronde finish with a touch of warmth. She’s styled sleek and straight with a center part.

All photos are taken in natural lighting.

You can care for and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled, and you may want to give her a light touch-up after unboxing if the style shifts during shipping.

All sales are final.
